_comment: Scales students use to prioritize their patients. settings.priorityScale picks one. The instructor hasn't chosen a triage system yet (SPEC §14); add another scale here as data only. type 'levels': each patient gets one level; each level lists the instructor tags it matches (used by the debrief and the priority-mismatch rule). 'tone' picks a display color (red, yellow, green, black, neutral).

levels.label: Red
levels.description: Immediate: unstable or at risk of rapid decline

levels.label: Yellow
levels.description: Urgent: needs care soon, currently stable
